bodyText: The increment of AI+ marketing mainly falls on advertising placement and customer operations, and we pay more attention to advertising platforms. The marketing process can be divided into 1) creative production, 2) advertising placement, 3) customer operations: AI respectively reduces content costs, improves placement efficiency, and reduces manual follow-up. The creative side faces customer price pressure, placement platforms can obtain more budget through performance improvement, and customer operations software is expected to increase paid demand. Among them, advertising platforms can directly monetize based on existing business, with the highest certainty.`n`1) AI enables advertisers to complete part of creative production themselves, and traditional agencies such as WPP face pressure from reduced outsourcing demand and lower service prices. In the past, enterprises usually outsourced copywriting, design, and creative production to agencies such as WPP, paying based on projects and labor input. After AI lowered the production threshold, some demand can be completed internally by enterprises, and remaining outsourcing projects also face price pressure, putting pressure on the traditional manual delivery and project-based charging model. Agencies can also reduce costs through AI, and final profitability depends on whether cost reduction can offset reduced demand and falling quotations.`n`2) Platforms that control placement and conversion data can more easily turn the efficiency improvement brought by AI into advertising revenue. Platforms combine click and actual purchase feedback to determine which creative suits which type of user, then adjust bids and budgets, so that the same advertising input brings more orders. As placement returns improve, advertisers are more motivated to increase budgets, and platform revenue is also expected to grow accordingly. Google, Meta, AppLovin, and Mobvista can all use continuously accumulated performance feedback to optimize placement, and we favor such platforms obtaining more advertising budget through performance advantages.`n`3) Customer operations software is expected to drive per-customer revenue growth through task-based charging. After advertising brings in potential customers, enterprises still need to complete consultation replies, lead screening, and sales follow-up. Companies such as Marketingforce and HubSpot have already accumulated customer information and business processes, and can embed Agents into these segments, with charging methods also beginning to be tied to the Agent's actual workload.`n`We suggest prioritizing platforms with measurable results, reusable services, and charging based on actual usage.`n`Beneficiary side: monetize revenue through placement engines, Agent-based delivery, and proprietary traffic/CRM closed loops.`n Hong Kong stocks: Mobvista (1860.HK), Marketingforce (2556.HK, Outperform, TP HK$82), Mininglamp Technology (2718.HK), Beijing DeepZero Technology (2723.HK).  `n A-shares: BlueFocus Intelligent Communications Group (300058.SZ), Easy Click Worldwide Network Technology (301171.SZ).  `n U.S. stocks: Alphabet (GOOGL.US / GOOG.US, Outperform, TP US$400), AppLovin (APP.US), HubSpot (HUBS.US), Meta (META.US, Outperform, TP US$700).  `nUnder-pressure side: The Trade Desk (TTD.US) faces pressure from budgets migrating to closed platforms; WPP (WPP.US)'s manual agency charging foundation is under pressure. `nRisks: data and privacy regulation, platform dependence, model homogenization and price cuts, brand safety and model hallucination, financial quality, expectation and valuation volatility, etc. `nCovered companies ratings: Tencent Holdings Outperform Target Price 480.00 PE(2026E) 13 PE(2027E) 13; Alibaba Outperform Target Price 140.00 PE(2026E) 17 PE(2027E) 30; Pinduoduo Outperform Target Price 100.00 PE(2026E) 7 PE(2027E) 7; Meituan Outperform Target Price 108.00 PE(2026E) 460 PE(2027E) 19; JD.com Outperform Target Price 34.00 PE(2026E) 9 PE(2027E) 7; Baidu Outperform Target Price 150.00 PE(2026E) 15 PE(2027E) 12; Z.AI Outperform Target Price 2200 PE(2026E) n.a.
